description: Land Acquisition - Rankothdiwela, Mawanella D/S Division, Kegalle District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired (including lot numbers, land names, claimants, and extents), notification procedures for interested parties, and compensation claims. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" specifically covering land acquisitions, which aligns perfectly with Type 4 (Land Gazettes) classification.
